$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema pointer for IDE validation.

id.description: Stable identifier for diffs and tooling.

kind.description: Tavily query profile: arxiv | nvidia | siemens | ansys | generic (or inferred from URL host).

rss.description: Optional RSS/Atom URL merged into the feed list (with built-in defaults in code; deduped by URL).

feed_hosts.description: Extra hostnames allowed for items from this feed (when item links differ from the feed host).

newsroom_listing.description: When true, use built-in discovery for id physicsx, neural-concept, emmi-ai, siemens, or p1-ai (P-1: press links on p-1.ai homepage) instead of relying on that domain from Tavily alone.
